notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-7); spending listed by object only. Business-type lines and balances from the proprietary funds statement Total column (p9; same figures as the Statement of Activities business-type column, pp2-5). Fund balances (p7) in the fund_balance fields; ending_cash = governmental Total Assets, all cash lines (p7); no beginning cash printed. Detail: General, Street and Building funds from the governmental combining schedules (receipts p10, disbursements p11); Playground Equipment Fund interest 0.12 from the Other Governmental Fund column (p6) since its schedule page is not in the trim. Light and Water funds from the proprietary combining budget schedule (p12); the Sewer Fund page of that schedule is not in the trim, so Sewer lines come from the proprietary statement's Sewer Fund column (p9). Budgets are printed only as all-fund columns or per-fund totals, so budget_final is null on lines. p13 unaudited combined summary repeats fund totals and is not recorded (except the Playground revenue total). Balance sheet: governmental from the governmental funds statement (pp7-8; totals equal the Statement of Net Position governmental column), business-type from the Statement of Net Position (p1). The Library component unit is excluded. Read pages 1-13 of 13
